name: GPTZero Online
tagline: GPTZero is a free AI text detection and writing-risk review tool
description: GPTZero is a free AI text detection and writing-risk review tool. Paste any draft to estimate AI-writing likelihood, inspect sentence-level signals, and decide whether the text needs further review before submission. Built for students, editors, content teams, and anyone who needs to understand AI-writing risk before adetector, teacher, client, or recruiter sees the draft. Supports 18 languages with real-time risk scoring and highlighted sentences.
